$comment: Config for the Go markdown linter built into this binary (plaesy validate markdown).
Same rule IDs and option keys as markdownlint-cli2, so this file is portable.
Unknown rule names and unknown option keys are hard errors: a config that half-loads
is a check that reports success while checking nothing.
MD010 ignores code blocks on purpose: a tab inside a fenced example is the content
being shown (a tab-delimited table, an indented Makefile recipe), not this
document's own formatting, and 'plaesy validate markdown --fix' would otherwise
rewrite the data of every example it passes over.
